text.description_html:
First Impressions Model 3456 Curved Stainless Steel Door Pull

This 1" diameter curved stainless steel door pull from First Impressions can be used in many applications such as residential front doors, commercial office entry doors, store front doors, large appliance doors, just about anywhere a large door pull is desired.

Long lasting Stainless Steel door pull with a very clean curved contemporary design. Available in your choice of Satin Stainless Steel or Polished Stainless Steel (Bright like Polished Chrome).

Specifications for First Impressions Model #3456 Door Pull

  • Pull Handle Length: approx. 14"
  • Center to Center: 11-3/8"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
  • Mounting Bracket Diameter: 7/8"
  • Total Projection: 2-5/8"
  • Pull Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Finish: Optional Satin Stainless Steel or Polished Stainless Steel

Note: The First Impressions Model #3456 door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including different center to center mounting distances and Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts through the door), optional Surface mounting (Bolts to the doors surface).
Also available: Pair of Model #8411 Back to Back Mounted door pulls for both sides of a door.

*Sold individually.
